findings.F1: Usage note falsely says during can take a clause with its own subject (*during we were eating*), contradicting learner_errors.
findings.F2: Sense 1 example 'I felt sick during three hours.' uses during with a length of time; it needs for.
findings.F3: Sense 1 signpost 'all through a period' has four words; limit is one to three.
findings.F4: Sense 2 signpost 'at some point within' has four words; limit is one to three.
findings.F5: The during/while contrast is stated in both the usage note and the first learner error (one fact, one field).
